regulations.basis: an SBOM must be JSON or XML and valid against CycloneDX 1.6+ or SPDX 3.0.1+
required SBOM-level field: date and time of the SBOM data compilation
required SBOM-level field: creator of the SBOM, given as an email address or URL
the primary component the SBOM describes has to be identifiable
required per-component fields: component name and component version
additional field: other unique identifiers such as PURL or CPE, required where they exist
dependencies on other components must be enumerated; the guideline requires recursive resolution within the scope of delivery, which is stricter than the CRA top-level minimum
required per-component field: the distribution licence under which the component may be used
required per-component field: a cryptographic checksum of the deployable component
the deployable-component checksum is specified as SHA-512
required per-component field: the entity that created and maintains the component, as an email address or URL
required per-component field: the actual filename of the component

checks.label: Source or distribution URI coverage (>= 80%, recommended)

regulations.basis: additional fields: the source code URI and the URI of the deployable form, required where they exist
required per-component fields: the executable, archive and structured properties, each determined by inspecting the delivered file
general description: what the AI system is and its intended purpose
transparency: the system must be identifiable as AI-operated to users
description of how data moves through and around the system
data flows are an input to the fundamental-rights impact assessment

reviewGuide.how: Write down how data moves through the system: where an input comes from, what the model receives, and where its output goes. Confirm the description matches how the system is actually deployed.
reviewGuide.howKo: 데이터가 시스템 안에서 어떻게 흐르는지 적습니다. 입력이 어디서 오고, 모델이 무엇을 받고, 출력이 어디로 가는지입니다. 적어 둔 내용이 실제 배포 구성과 맞는지 확인합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 寫下資料在系統中的流動方式：輸入從哪裡來、模型收到什麼、輸出流向哪裡。並確認這份描述與系統實際部署的方式相符。

regulations.basis: how data is used by the system
data usage informs the fundamental-rights impact assessment

reviewGuide.how: State what the system does with the data it receives — whether it is stored, passed to another component, or used for further training. Check this against the privacy notice you publish.
reviewGuide.howKo: 시스템이 받은 데이터를 어떻게 쓰는지 밝힙니다. 저장하는지, 다른 구성요소로 넘기는지, 추가 학습에 쓰는지입니다. 공개하는 개인정보 처리방침과 어긋나지 않는지 확인합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 說明系統如何處理收到的資料——是儲存、傳給另一個元件，還是用於進一步訓練。並對照你們公開的隱私權聲明加以檢查。

regulations.basis: how the system interacts with hardware/software and its input-output surface

reviewGuide.how: Describe the input and output the system accepts and produces — formats, size limits, and anything it refuses. A person confirms this because a model card lists modalities, not the system's actual interface.
reviewGuide.howKo: 시스템이 받는 입력과 내놓는 출력을 적습니다. 형식과 크기 제한, 받지 않는 입력까지 포함합니다. 모델 카드에는 처리 방식만 적히고 시스템의 실제 인터페이스는 드러나지 않아 사람이 확인해야 합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 描述系統接受的輸入與產生的輸出——格式、大小限制，以及會拒絕的內容。模型卡列出的是模態，而非系統的實際介面，因此需要人工確認。

regulations.basis: intended purpose and application area of the system
whether the system is high-impact AI is judged by its application area

reviewGuide.how: State the field the system is intended for and the uses that are out of scope. This is a decision, not a fact a tool can read, and regulators ask for it directly.
reviewGuide.howKo: 시스템을 어느 분야에 쓰려고 만들었는지, 쓰지 말아야 할 용도는 무엇인지 밝힙니다. 도구가 읽어낼 수 있는 사실이 아니라 판단이며, 규제에서 직접 요구하는 항목입니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 說明系統的預期應用領域，以及不在範圍內的用途。這是一項判斷，不是工具能讀取的事實，而且監管機關會直接要求提供。

regulations.basis: general description of the model
design specifications, algorithmic logic and system architecture
capabilities and limitations of the model's functioning (input-output behaviour)
training methodologies, techniques and the training datasets used
safety: lifecycle risk identification covers how the model was trained

checks.label: Model license — openness (weight/architecture/data/training)
checks.labelZh: 模型授權條款 — 開放程度（權重／架構／資料／訓練）

regulations.basis: the datasets (datasheets) the model was trained on
description of the training data and its main characteristics
what the training data contains (scope and main characteristics)
provenance of the data: where it came from and how it was acquired and selected
main characteristics of the data (statistical properties)

reviewGuide.how: Give the size and shape of the training data — record counts, class balance, and any known skew. These numbers explain the model's limits, so state them even when they are unflattering.
reviewGuide.howKo: 학습 데이터의 규모와 구성을 적습니다. 건수, 분류별 비율, 알고 있는 치우침입니다. 이 수치가 모델의 한계를 설명하므로 불리한 내용이라도 밝힙니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 提供訓練資料的規模與組成——筆數、類別比例，以及已知的偏斜。這些數字說明模型的限制，即使結果不理想也應如實陳述。

checks.label: Dataset sensitivity (PII/copyright)
checks.labelZh: 資料集敏感性（個人資料／著作權）

regulations.basis: data characteristics including sensitive or personal data
data sensitivity is central to the fundamental-rights impact assessment

reviewGuide.how: Judge whether the training data holds personal information or third-party copyrighted work, and record what you filtered out and how. Where the answer is unclear, take it to your privacy and legal contacts before release.
reviewGuide.howKo: 학습 데이터에 개인정보나 타인의 저작물이 섞였는지 판단하고, 무엇을 어떻게 걸러냈는지 기록합니다. 판단이 서지 않으면 공개 전에 개인정보 담당 부서와 법무에 확인합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 判斷訓練資料是否含有個人資料或第三方著作，並記錄過濾了哪些內容、如何過濾。若無法確定，請在發佈前洽詢隱私與法務窗口。

regulations.basis: how the training data was acquired (rights to use it)
software components and computational resources used

checks.label: Infrastructure hardware (HBOM link)
checks.labelZh: 基礎設施硬體（HBOM 連結）

regulations.basis: the hardware on which the system runs
cybersecurity controls built into the system
safety: risk-mitigation controls across the lifecycle

reviewGuide.how: List the controls that protect the model and its data — who can reach the weights, how the training environment is isolated, how artefacts are signed. These live in your operations, not in the SBOM.
reviewGuide.howKo: 모델과 데이터를 보호하는 통제 수단을 적습니다. 가중치에 누가 접근할 수 있는지, 학습 환경을 어떻게 분리하는지, 산출물에 어떻게 서명하는지입니다. SBOM이 아니라 운영 쪽에 있는 정보입니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 列出保護模型與其資料的控制措施——誰能存取權重、訓練環境如何隔離、產出物如何簽章。這些資訊屬於營運環節，而非 SBOM 本身。

reviewGuide.how: Name the security standard or internal policy this model was built under, and who signed off. Point at the assessment record rather than restating it here.
reviewGuide.howKo: 이 모델이 어떤 보안 표준이나 사내 정책을 따라 만들어졌는지, 누가 승인했는지 밝힙니다. 내용을 옮겨 적기보다 점검 기록을 가리키는 편이 낫습니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 指明此模型依循哪項安全標準或內部政策建置，以及由誰核准。提供評估紀錄的參照即可，不必在此複述內容。

regulations.basis: risk-management system (Article 9) documentation
safety: the required risk-management framework

reviewGuide.how: Give the route for reporting a vulnerability in this model and who answers it. A published model needs a contact that outlives the person who trained it.
reviewGuide.howKo: 이 모델의 취약점을 어디로 신고하고 누가 답하는지 적습니다. 공개한 모델에는 학습한 사람이 자리를 옮겨도 유지되는 연락처가 필요합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 提供此模型弱點的通報管道，以及由誰回應。已發佈的模型需要一個不隨訓練者離開而失效的聯絡窗口。

regulations.basis: cybersecurity: known vulnerabilities affecting the system
safety: monitoring and responding to AI-related risks
cybersecurity measures and their metrics
safety: security metrics feed the risk-management system

reviewGuide.how: Record what you measured on the security side — adversarial or jailbreak testing, refusal rates, red-team results — with the method and the date. If nothing was measured, say so plainly.
reviewGuide.howKo: 보안 쪽에서 무엇을 측정했는지 기록합니다. 적대적 입력이나 우회 시도 시험, 거부율, 모의 공격 결과를 방법·시점과 함께 적습니다. 측정하지 않았다면 하지 않았다고 그대로 밝힙니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 記錄在安全面向量測了什麼——對抗式或越獄測試、拒絕率、紅隊演練結果——並附上方法與日期。若未進行任何量測，請直接說明。

regulations.basis: validation and testing metrics for accuracy and robustness; performance-metric appropriateness
the name of the entity that creates the SBOM data for the target component
a digital signature attributable to the SBOM author

reviewGuide.how: A signature delivered beside the SBOM rather than inside it does not appear here, because this report reads one file. If the SBOM arrived with a detached signature, verify it against the sender's key before treating the contents as theirs, and record that you did. A signature carried inside the document is read automatically and this row will say so.
reviewGuide.howKo: SBOM 안이 아니라 파일 옆에 따로 온 서명은 이 보고서에 나타나지 않습니다. 보고서가 파일 하나만 읽기 때문입니다. 분리 서명과 함께 받았다면 보낸 쪽의 키로 검증한 뒤 내용을 그쪽의 것으로 취급하고, 검증했다는 사실을 기록해 둡니다. 문서 안에 담긴 서명은 자동으로 읽히며 그 경우 이 행에 표시됩니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 隨 SBOM 送達、但不在檔案之內的簽章不會出現在此處，因為本報告只讀取單一檔案。若 SBOM 附有分離簽章，請先以寄送方的金鑰驗證，再將內容視為出自對方，並記錄已完成驗證。內嵌於文件中的簽章會自動讀取，本列也會如實顯示。

regulations.basis: the name of the data format used to represent the SBOM data
the version of the data format named above
the lifecycle phase and data available when the SBOM was generated, such as before or after build
the date and time of the most recent update to the SBOM data, following RFC 9557
the tool the SBOM author used to generate or amend the SBOM
the version of that tool, stated as unknown when no identifier is available
an identifier distinguishing this SBOM from earlier iterations for the same component and version
the name the component producer assigned to the component
the producer's version identifier, stated as unknown when none was provided
the entity that creates, defines and identifies the component; replaces the 2021 element Supplier Name
at least one software identifier such as PURL or CPE, or an intrinsic one such as a hash
the identifiers for the licenses under which the component is available
the hash of the executable component artifact, stated as unknown when the artifact is out of reach
the algorithm that produced the hash, named by its IANA hash function textual name
the relationship between two components where one is necessary for the operation of the other
the SBOM uses a widely used, open, machine-processable format
information for every component making up the target software, including transitive dependencies, with no minimum depth

reviewGuide.how: Establish that the SBOM lists every component making up the software, transitive dependencies included. No tool can confirm this from the document alone — the document cannot show what was left out of it. Compare it against the build's own dependency resolution, or against the manifests the software is built from.
reviewGuide.howKo: SBOM이 소프트웨어를 이루는 구성요소를 이행 의존성까지 빠짐없이 담았는지 확인합니다. 문서만 보고는 어떤 도구도 판정할 수 없습니다. 문서는 자기가 빠뜨린 것을 보여 주지 못하기 때문입니다. 빌드가 실제로 해석한 의존성이나 빌드에 쓰인 매니페스트와 대조합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 確認 SBOM 已列出組成軟體的所有元件，包含間接相依。僅憑文件本身，任何工具都無法確認這一點——文件呈現不出自己遺漏了什麼。請與建置本身的相依性解析結果，或與軟體建置所依據的 manifest 比對。

checks.label: Accommodation of updates to SBOM data
checks.labelZh: SBOM 資料更新因應機制

regulations.ref: Accommodation of Updates to SBOM Data
regulations.basis: corrections and updates to published SBOM data are accommodated and issued promptly

reviewGuide.how: Establish that there is a way to correct SBOM data after it has been published, and that corrections go out promptly. This is a practice of the organisation issuing the SBOM, not a field in it.
reviewGuide.howKo: 발행한 SBOM 데이터를 나중에 정정할 방법이 있고 정정본이 지체 없이 나가는지 확인합니다. 문서 안의 필드가 아니라 SBOM을 발행하는 조직의 관행에 대한 항목입니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 確認 SBOM 發佈後仍可更正其資料，且更正版能及時發佈。這是發行 SBOM 的組織作業實務，而非文件中的欄位。

regulations.basis: the SBOM is available promptly to those who need it, with access controls that do not block authorized parties

reviewGuide.how: Establish that whoever needs the SBOM can get it promptly, and that any access control keeps unauthorized parties out without blocking authorized ones or preventing the data from being loaded into their security tools.
reviewGuide.howKo: SBOM이 필요한 쪽이 지체 없이 받을 수 있는지, 접근 통제가 권한 없는 쪽을 막되 권한 있는 쪽의 수신이나 보안 도구로의 반입까지 막지는 않는지 확인합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 確認需要 SBOM 的一方能即時取得，且任何存取控制在阻擋未經授權者之餘，不會擋住已授權的一方，也不會妨礙資料匯入其安全工具。

regulations.basis: a value that is absent is stated as unknown to the author or as withheld, and the two are distinguished
each software version or update has an associated SBOM, and a corrected SBOM is reissued when data changes

reviewGuide.how: Establish that each software version or update has an SBOM of its own, and that a revised SBOM is issued when the component data changes or an error in it is found.
reviewGuide.howKo: 소프트웨어 버전이나 업데이트마다 자기 SBOM이 있는지, 구성요소 데이터가 바뀌거나 오류를 발견했을 때 정정본을 다시 내는지 확인합니다.
reviewGuide.howZh: 確認每個軟體版本或更新都有自己的 SBOM，且在元件資料變動或發現其中有誤時，會發出修訂版 SBOM。

regulatoryCrosswalk.disclaimer: BomLens does not certify or determine compliance with the EU AI Act, the Korean AI Framework Act, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, or any other regulation. This crosswalk covers only the documentation elements an SBOM can carry; obligations that an SBOM cannot express — bias and fairness assessment, risk management, human oversight — are out of its scope and must be met through separate documents. It makes documentation gaps visible so a person can prepare; interpreting it against a specific product's legal obligations is a person's job.
